title: Standing rule: either conductor applies owner-approved once the owner approves that PR's merge in its session
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Delegation And Merge Policy" says a Solo or Orchestrator session on either conductor applies owner-approved once the owner approves that PR's merge in its session, after recording the owner's words as a PR comment; no separate instruction to apply the label is needed, and agents still never apply it on their own judgment.
"Never granted", the Two-machine conductors bullet, the PR template and agent-prompts/delegate-task.md say the same.

evidence.summary: Owner's standing rule and chosen scope in the Neo session: apply owner-approved on the owner's per-PR approval, not at will.
AGENTS.md delegation policy, Never granted and conductors bullet, PR template and delegate-task.md updated.

resolution: Either conductor now applies owner-approved once the owner approves that PR's merge in its session, after recording the owner's words as a PR comment; agents still never apply it on their own judgment, and the owner still approves every PR.
